# archestra_knowledge_base (Data Source)

Finds a knowledge base by its exact name among those these credentials can see, for example to assign one created in the UI to an agent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reference a knowledge base created in the UI by name.
data "archestra_knowledge_base" "handbook" {
  name = "Employee handbook"
}

output "handbook_knowledge_base_id" {
  value = data.archestra_knowledge_base.handbook.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact name of the knowledge base.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Knowledge base description.
- `id` (String) Knowledge Base ID.
- `team_ids` (List of String) Teams the knowledge base is shared with.
- `visibility` (String) Who the knowledge base is shared with.
